events.summary: Speaker D decided the first product is a television remote control.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: so we'll start with the remote control for television then

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a very user-friendly, visual remote that draws people to buy it.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: we're have to design something that is very user friendly

events.summary: Speaker C reported that they had understood the project as a new monitor, not a remote control, so no design work had started.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I thought we were designing a new monitor

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a fashionable, iPod-like product that looks cool and is recognised on sight.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: something like the iPod would be good, seems to have caught on fairly well

events.summary: Speaker C estimated the functional and technical design would take one month if it goes quickly, or six months if there are problems.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: If they uh go quickly then uh it could be a month

events.summary: Speaker A required the written plan to cover functional design, technical design, team size, time frame and budget.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: what's your functional design, what's your technical design, and uh how many people you need for this project

events.summary: Speaker C committed to a written project plan in two weeks, which Speaker A accepted.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: two weeks is a is close enough

events.summary: Speaker D proposed picking a fairly large market, with a product that is new and draws people in.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: It should be a fairly large market

events.summary: Speaker A asked Speaker D to produce the sales plan, working with Speaker C on the technical side, and to decide the cost and price.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: you need to come up with some kind of plan, okay, how we are going to do the your sales plan

events.summary: Speaker A proposed that Speaker B act as the coordinator between the teams.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you are my coordinator, am I right

events.summary: Speaker B objected that the coordinating role does not fit, since the job is usability and interaction with Speaker C.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I don't think necessarily that I'm in a coordinating position

events.summary: Speaker B said all three groups, industrial design, usability and marketing, need to interact a lot.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So I think all three groups will need to interact quite a bit

events.summary: Speaker A decided Speaker D must be kept in the loop on meetings between Speaker B and Speaker C.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: keep Ed in the loop, okay, in between your uh meeting and Christine meeting

events.summary: Speaker A asked Speaker B to copy all emails and discussions to Speaker A, so the project can be reported to management.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: please copy all the mails, okay, all the discussions to me

events.summary: Speaker B set the immediate next step as determining the functional design, which Speaker A confirmed.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the immediate next step is to start determining the functional design

events.summary: Speaker A committed to keep and share all the emails and copies so everyone knows what is happening.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: let us keep all the emails and all the copies, okay, share each other
